exercises.question: Which sentence makes a comparison?
options: La comida casera suele ser más barata que comer fuera. [Homemade food is usually cheaper than eating out.]
La comida casera suele ser bastante saludable para toda la familia. [Homemade food is usually quite healthy for the whole family.]
Preparo comida casera todas las noches después de volver del trabajo. [I prepare homemade food every night after returning from work.]
